A: Choose a fix based on the confirmed root cause and evaluate risk before acting

5.1.Q: Implement the solution or escalate as necessary
A: Apply the approved fix when it is within your authority and skill set
Escalate with clear documentation when the issue is outside scope, requires higher privileges, or needs another team/vendor
